dataset_description.description: An optional dataset_description.json to be uploaded to OpenNeuro. This will be prioritized over other sources of dataset_description.json files and will overwrite an existing copy on openneuro.org. Providing this input also allows the gear to run even when no sessions are available for upload (e.g. to patch just the dataset_description.json on an existing dataset).

accession_number.description: Accession number of the OpenNeuro dataset to upload to. Leave blank if generating a new dataset.

skip_upload.description: If True, the gear will not attempt to upload any data. This may be useful when trying to generate a new OpenNeuro Dataset without actually uploading any data.

generate_new_dataset.description: If True, the gear will generate a new OpenNeuro dataset and accession number. Requires 'defaced' to be set.

defaced.description:
Required if generate_new_dataset is true.
True: all structural scans have been defaced, obscuring any tissue on or near the face that could potentially be used to reconstruct the facial structure.
False: I have explicit participant consent and ethical authorization to publish structural scans without defacing.
enum: true: all structural scans have been defaced, obscuring any tissue on or near the face that could potentially be used to reconstruct the facial structure.
false: I have explicit participant consent and ethical authorization to publish structural scans without defacing.

copy_to_project_info.description: If True, the gear will copy the accession number and OpenNeuro URL to project info. Future gear runs will pull these fields so they don't need to be inputted each time.

strip_sessions.description: If True, the gear will remove the session level from the BIDS directory structure and from filenames (sub-XX/ses-YY/<modality>/sub-XX_ses-YY_*.* -> sub-XX/<modality>/sub-XX_*.*). Errors out if any subject has more than one session (filename collisions would result) or if any subject-level sessions.tsv/.json files exist (resolve those manually before enabling).
